text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: metering-heartbeat anomaly detected for prod-region-us-east. token_count delta > 60% vs baseline for last 5m. Overage flags fired for 3 customers. Paging oncall.

alice-oncall: on it. linking metering + billing. tagging @rob-metering and @tara-billing. any initial customer impact known?

rob-metering: seeing increased token deltas from ingest pipeline replay window. looks like a late-batch re-ingest hit the aggregator for a subset of accounts.

maya-cs: customers CUST-482, CUST-911, CUST-305 got automated overage emails 2m ago. I'm pausing notifications from the alerts console.

tara-billing: paused alerting acknowledged. can we confirm counts are actual vs duplicate? need to avoid refunds if it's a duplicate replay.

rob-metering: quick adhoc query (run against live-summarizer):
```
SELECT account_id, sum(tokens) as tokens_5m, ingest_source, window_id
FROM metering.events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '10 minutes'
GROUP BY account_id, ingest_source, window_id
ORDER BY tokens_5m DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
results show `ingest_source='replay-worker'` for the top deltas. looks like backfill task retried twice.

alice-oncall: action items: 1) stop automated overage emails (maya done), 2) put billing into suppression mode (tara), 3) isolate replay pipeline and stop further replays (rob), 4) reconcile and dedupe events for affected windows (rob + SRE).

sre-lead: I'm standing by to isolate the replay job. tagging infra: disable job `backfill-replayer-prod` for now. also throttling write QPS to aggregator to limit amplification.

rob-metering: will run dedupe script on affected windows. quick command to preview duplicates: 
```
python tools/count_diff.py --start=2026-03-16T22:10Z --end=2026-03-16T22:20Z --account=CUST-482
# preview shows 2x duplicates on shard-3
```

tara-billing: enabling short suppression (30m) on billing pipelines and disabling automated charge flags for the three accounts. logging a temporary manual hold so accounting doesn't auto-invoice.

maya-cs: informing customers with a short note: "We're investigating an ingestion duplication that triggered an overage alert. We've paused billing notifications and will follow up in 60 minutes." Sending now.

alice-oncall: timeline so far: 22:00 alert, 22:02 overage emails, 22:04 paging, 22:07 suppression + job disabled, 22:12 dedupe preview. Keep updates short.

rob-metering: running dedupe job now (dry-run). ETA ~8m. will post results.

incident-bot: RUNBOOK step: if duplicate replay confirmed -> run `metering.dedup.apply(window_id)` then re-run billing summarize. If more than 5% revenue delta, escalate to finance.

rob-metering: dry-run complete — duplicates detected: approx +54% tokens for windows [w:20260316-2210 .. w:20260316-2215] on shard-3. No other regions affected.

tara-billing: compute expected delta and hold decisions: running reconcile. preliminary: estimated monetary impact rollback ~ $0.0 (customers not charged yet due to suppression). planning to revert auto-flag state and redact overage emails.

maya-cs: queued a customer follow-up template for manual send after we confirm cleanup.

alice-oncall: good. next steps: (A) rob run dedup apply (non-dry) for those windows, (B) tara keep suppression until reconcile completes, (C) maya wait for final confirmation before outbound comms. If dedup fails or uncovers additional accounts, escalate to SRE + infra.

rob-metering: starting apply now. posting logs.
```
[22:23:10] dedup.apply window=w:20260316-2210 shard=3 status=started
[22:24:45] dedup.apply window=w:20260316-2210 shard=3 removed=1,234,567 tokens
[22:26:01] dedup.apply window range complete. total_removed=3,456,789 tokens
```

rob-metering: finished. re-running summarize. new token delta back to baseline (+3%).

tara-billing: recon complete. suppression lifted but we keep auto-emailing off for 15m for safety. recording post-incident hold for accounting review.

sre-lead: confirmed `backfill-replayer-prod` disabled and failing fast on retries. will add a safety check to prevent double-apply for overlapping windows. filing infra ticket INFRA-2026.

alice-oncall: incident status: mitigated -> dedup applied, billing suppressed, customers notified of investigation. postmortem required. owners: rob (metering), tara (billing), sre-lead (infra).

maya-cs: sending personalized notes to affected customers now. copy of message for audit attached to ticket.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to MONITORING. please update the incident tracker and add timeline. :white_check_mark:
